lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਏ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaval pragaas bhae saadhasa(n)ge duramat budh tiaagee ||2||
lines.translation: My heart lotus blossoms forth in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I have renounced evil-mindedness and intellectualism. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har ke gun gaavai simarai deen daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, and remembers the Lord in meditation, who is Kind to the poor,

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਭ ਉਧਰੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aap tarai sa(n)gat sabh udharai binase sagal ja(n)jaalaa ||3||
lines.translation: saves himself, and redeems all his generations; all of his bonds are released. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan adhaar teraa prabh suaamee ot pot prabh saath ||
lines.translation: I take the Support of Your Feet, O God, O Lord and Master; you are with me through and through, God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: saran pario naanak prabh tumaree de raakhio har haath ||4||2||32||
lines.translation: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, God; giving him His hand, the Lord has protected him. ||4||2||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree asatapadeeaa mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਗਰੀ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਬਸੀਅਲੇ ਬਰਜਤ ਚੋਰੀ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek nagaree pa(n)ch chor baseeale barajat choree dhaavai ||
lines.translation: In the one village of the body, live the five thieves; they have been warned, but they still go out stealing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਹਦਸ ਮਾਲ ਰਖੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: trihadas maal rakhai jo naanak mokh mukat so paavai ||1||
lines.translation: One who keeps his assets safe from the three modes and the ten passions, O Nanak, attains liberation and emancipation. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਹੁ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਉ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chetahu baasudeu banavaalee ||
lines.translation: Center your mind on the all-pervading Lord, the Wearer of garlands of the jungles.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam ridai japamaalee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Let your rosary be the chanting of the Lord's Name in your heart. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਰਧ ਮੂਲ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਖ ਤਲਾਹਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: uradh mool jis saakh talaahaa chaar bed jit laage ||
lines.translation: Its roots extend upwards, and its branches reach down; the four Vedas are attached to it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj bhaai jaai te naanak paarabraham liv jaage ||2||
lines.translation: He alone reaches this tree with ease, O Nanak, who remains wakeful in the Love of the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਗਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਪੁਹਪ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਤਤੁ ਡਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarajaat ghar aagan merai puhap patr tat daalaa ||
lines.translation: The Elysian Tree is the courtyard of my house; in it are the flowers, leaves and stems of reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸੰਭੂ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sarab jot nira(n)jan sa(n)bhoo chhodahu bahut ja(n)jaalaa ||3||
lines.translation: Meditate on the self-existent, immaculate Lord, whose Light is pervading everywhere; renounce all your worldly entanglements. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਵੰਤੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੈ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sikhava(n)te naanak binavai chhodahu maaiaa jaalaa ||
lines.translation: Listen, O seekers of Truth - Nanak begs you to renounce the traps of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: man beechaar ek liv laagee punarap janam na kaalaa ||4||
lines.translation: Reflect within your mind, that by enshrining love for the One Lord, you shall not be subject to birth and death again. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਸੋ ਵੈਦੁ ਜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੋਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: so guroo so sikh katheeale so vaid j jaanai rogee ||
lines.translation: He alone is said to be a Guru, he alone is said to be a Sikh, and he alone is said to be a physician, who knows the patient's illness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕੰਮੁ ਨ ਧੰਧਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜੋਗੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: tis kaaran ka(n)m na dha(n)dhaa naahee dha(n)dhai girahee jogee ||5||
lines.translation: He is not affected by actions, responsibilities and entanglements; in the entanglements of his household, he maintains the detachment of Yoga. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar tajeeale lobh mohu tis maaiaa ||
lines.translation: He renounces sexual desire, anger, egotism, greed, attachment and Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਤੁ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: man tat avigat dhiaaiaa gur parasaadee paaiaa ||6||
lines.translation: Within his mind, he meditates on the reality of the Imperishable Lord; by Guru's Grace he finds Him. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਭ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਸੇਤ ਬਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan dhiaan sabh daat katheeale set baran sabh dootaa ||
lines.translation: Spiritual wisdom and meditation are all said to be God's gifts; all of the demons are turned white before him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਮਲ ਮਧੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਰਸਾਦੰ ਜਾਗਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: braham kamal madh taas rasaada(n) jaagat naahee sootaa ||7||
lines.translation: He enjoys the taste of the honey of God's lotus; he remains awake, and does not fall asleep. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੁਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa ga(n)bheer patr paataalaa naanak sarab juaaiaa ||
lines.translation: This lotus is very deep; its leaves are the nether regions, and it is connected to the whole universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਮ ਪੁਨਹਿ ਨ ਗਰਭੰ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਜਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: upades guroo mam punahi na garabha(n) bikh taj a(n)mrit peeaaiaa ||8||1||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, I shall not have to enter the womb again; I have renounced the poison of corruption, and I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||8||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਰਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan kavan jaachahi prabh daate taa ke a(n)t na parahi sumaar ||
lines.translation: Those who beg of God the Great Giver - their numbers cannot be counted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ਹੋਇ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaisee bhookh hoi abh a(n)tar too(n) samarath sach devanahaar ||1||
lines.translation: You, Almighty True Lord, fulfill the desires within their hearts. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐ ਜੀ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ai jee jap tap sa(n)jam sach adhaar ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, chanting, deep meditation, self-discipline and truth are my foundations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam dehi sukh paaeeai teree bhagat bhare bha(n)daar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Bless me with Your Name, Lord, that I may find peace. Your devotional worship is a treasure over-flowing. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਏਕਾ ਏਕੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)n samaadh rahahi liv laage ekaa ekee sabad beechaar ||
lines.translation: Some remain absorbed in Samaadhi, their minds fixed lovingly on the One Lord; they reflect only on the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲੁ ਥਲੁ ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal dharan gagan tah naahee aape aap keeaa karataar ||2||
lines.translation: In that state, there is no water, land, earth or sky; only the Creator Lord Himself exists. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨੁ ਨ ਛਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਸੂਰਜ ਚੰਦ ਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa tad maaiaa magan na chhaaiaa naa sooraj cha(n)d na jot apaar ||
lines.translation: There is no intoxication of Maya there, and no shadow, nor the infinite light of the sun or the moon.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਸੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sarab drisat lochan abh a(n)tar ekaa nadar s tribhavan saar ||3||
lines.translation: The eyes within the mind which see everything - with one glance, they see the three worlds. ||3||
